physics-killer-06.material: Dusha jiifka ah ee aan marayn, shay A oo cufnaantiisu tahay $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ayaa ku socda $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ oo la dhacaya shay B oo cufnaantiisu tahay $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ nasasho ah; labada shay waa is-dhegaan oo u dhaqmaan sida mid. Haddii isku dhacu socdo $0.05\,\mathrm{s}$, doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, xawaaraha labada shay isla markiiba ka dib isku dhaca iyo cabbirka celceliska xoogga B inta lagu jiro isku dhaca?
physics-killer-06.thinking.0: Is dhaca iyo badbaado, mashruuc toosan iyo cufis-jiidasho
physics-killer-06.s.s1.prompt: Dusha jiifka ah ee aan marayn, shay A oo cufnaantiisu tahay $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ ayaa ku socda $6\,\mathrm{m/s}$ oo la dhacaya shay B oo cufnaantiisu tahay $4\,\mathrm{kg}$ nasasho ah; labada shay waa is-dhegaan oo u dhaqmaan sida mid. Haddii isku dhacu socdo $0.05\,\mathrm{s}$, doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, xawaaraha labada shay isla markiiba ka dib isku dhaca iyo cabbirka celceliska xoogga B inta lagu jiro isku dhaca?
physics-killer-06.s.s1.explain: Ilaalinta momentum-ka: $2\cdot6=(2+4)v\Rightarrow v=2\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Isbeddelka momentum-ka B waa $\Delta p_B=4\cdot2-0=8\,\mathrm{kg\cdot m/s}$, sidaas darteed $F_{avg}=\dfrac{8}{0.05}=160\,\mathrm{N}$. (Isbeddelka momentum-ka A $2(2-6)=-8$ wuxuu leeyahay isla cabbirka, waana isku waafaqsan yahay.) Isticmaalka $m_A$ oo keliya sida u-qaybiyaha wuxuu bixiyaa $v=3\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (doodda 1); isticmaalka momentum-ka bilowga A ee $12$ xisaabta xoogga wuxuu bixiyaa $240\,\mathrm{N}$ (doodda 2); isticmaalka $v_B=4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ ee isku dhaca elastic-ka wuxuu bixiyaa doodda 3.
